<!-- pr-reviewer: 1cce59a57e689ee3d66ec2b8128dea78a8e369c4 -->
Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4117, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes stock simulation (the iso-surface of the field stock).

## What is good

- The snap test reads `|da|`, `|db|` and `|da - db|`. These are the same numbers from the two ends of an edge. Thus two tetrahedra that share an edge snap together or not at all. Both `|da|` and `|db|` cannot be under `1e-6 * span` on one crossed edge, so the order of the two checks has no effect.
- A snapped corner returns the sample point itself. The facets that collapse on it are exactly zero-area, and `push` already drops them (`iso.rs:246`).
- The inside/outside classification of the samples does not change. Only the corner position moves, by at most 1e-6 of an edge.
- The change also reaches production through the dual fallback (`iso.rs:98`): an open dual mesh uses `marching`. That path now also gets the fix.
- The integration pins join the existing `stock_dual` suite. No new test binary.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/4107-marching-node-snap.md` records the choice and the dropped options.
- The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #4107`. No golden, `*.nc`, `*.cl` or catalog file changes.

## Results (local, trial merge with upstream/main `a1c57b475`)

The PR head already contains upstream/main `a1c57b475`. The trial merge was "Already up to date".

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | green, 4 steps, 0 failed, 3.3 min |
| - sim build (`--no-run`) | ok |
| - sim suites: lib | ok |
| - sim suites: stock_dual (7 tests) | ok |
| - app suites: stock_export | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Mutations (run by this reviewer)

| Mutation in `tet`'s `cross` | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. Remove the two snap checks (old code) | RED: `a_floor_on_the_lattice_meshes_to_a_valid_solid_by_marching_tetrahedra` gives `(11394, 5799)`, the same as the body reading. `a_snapped_corner_is_the_sample_itself` is also red. |
| 2. Snapped corner computed as `pa + (pb - pa)` | RED: `a_snapped_corner_is_the_sample_itself` |
| 3. Snap test on the fraction `t` (the rejected first form) | RED: `an_edge_gets_the_same_corner_from_either_end_at_the_snap_threshold` (`value 1.0000010000001529e-6: 0 from inside, 0.0000010000000000287557 from outside`) |

After each mutation the file was restored. The quick gate ran on the unchanged head.

## Extra suites run

- Test data: the diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no fixture or golden directory. No extra suite applies.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. No extra suite applies.
- `example_catalog`: not run. The diff does not touch posts, operations, motion or the catalog.

## Light and heavy lanes

- Light lane: not run on this head. The light lane has six fixed steps in `camcraft-motion` and `pocket_pass_start` of `camcraft-app`. None of them calls `stock_sim::iso` (`extract_with`, `extract_at` or `marching`). The author ran `cargo xtask gate light` green (6 steps, 0 failed) on `6a11bbc7f`. The later commits change only `iso.rs` and `stock_dual.rs`.
- Heavy lanes: not run. This is a `P3` PR, so no heavy step applies (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `iso.rs` grows from 293 to 369 lines. It stays under the 400-line limit.
- The body says that a crossing between 1e-6 of an edge and the f32 rounding step can still collapse after an f32 export. This is a known limit, recorded in the decision file. A follow-up issue for a stricter `open_edges` (each edge on exactly two facets) is optional (P7).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
